title: Update Documentation Result
description: Return of the update-documentation agent when its prompt gives paths: the pb key it was given, any open ambiguity, the proposed commit subject and the docs it changed, which pb checkpoint reads. An empty list means no change

pb_key.description: The key from the prompt, copied exactly

ambiguity.description: Only a question a human must answer before the work can be trusted, phrased as a question (such as what the docs should say where the task does not say), or an empty string. Explanations of your choices go in notes, never here

notes.description: What you want to explain about your choices, in plain words, or an empty string. No gate reads it and it never stops the run

commit_subject.description: Proposed commit subject line, or an empty string when nothing changed

files_changed.description: Repo-relative paths of files the agent modified
